verdict.rationale: Asana documents built-in AI Teammates: pre-built and custom agents that 'work alongside your team inside real workflows' and 'handle the complex, coordination-heavy work.' They have shared memory, scoped permissions and audit trails, and are exposed as agent records in the API, plus an in-product 'AI Chief of Staff' (Asana Dash). Together this clearly supports delegating work to an AI assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the delegation mechanics (e.g., assigning a task to an AI Teammate and how it executes), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works in practice.
